name: github-heatmap
title: GitHub Heatmap
description: Two heatmaps in one: the original neon GitHub contribution grid with glowing theme presets, and a machined variant from the design system, where the grid is cut into a recessed tray and busier days are lit brighter until they rise into the popout. Both fetch live data for @ajinkya-cell, with streak stats, tooltips and month focus filtering.
